summary: Comprehensive testing of all new features: 11 admin tabs, new sidebar views (On Demand/Recordings/What's New), EPG grid keyboard navigation, CVR, Media Library, Notifications, VOD, Branding/Logo/Master PIN, Channel Quality/Type dropdowns, EPG Media File dropdown. All 25 backend API tests pass. All frontend test scenarios verified. One code bug found in channel edit form.

ui_bugs.issue: When editing an existing channel, the quality_label and channel_type fields are NOT restored from the channel object. The setChannelForm only sets {name, number, description}. This means editing a 4K channel will reset its quality_label to '1080p' and channel_type to 'live' unless the user manually changes them before saving.

issues: Date field uses browser native date picker (type='date') instead of shadcn calendar component - minor UI inconsistency
Line 14: `const BRANDING_DIR = '/app/backend/uploads/branding'` is a server-side path exposed but never used in frontend code - should be removed

action_items: Fix handleEditChannel in AdminDashboard.jsx to restore quality_label and channel_type from channel object: add `quality_label: channel.quality_label || '1080p', channel_type: channel.channel_type || 'live', stream_url: channel.stream_url || ''` to the setChannelForm call
Remove unused BRANDING_DIR constant from BrandingTab.jsx line 14
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: handleEditChannel (AdminDashboard.jsx line 196-206) doesn't restore quality_label, channel_type, or stream_url from the channel object - all three are missing from the setChannelForm call. When editing a channel, these fields silently reset to defaults.
CODE SMELL: BrandingTab.jsx line 14 has `const BRANDING_DIR = '/app/backend/uploads/branding'` - an unused server-side path constant in the frontend, should be removed.
NOTE: Previous iteration issue - GET /api/users has no auth check. Still not fixed (not in scope for this iteration).

success_rate.frontend: 97% (all test scenarios pass; 1 code bug found in channel edit form)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed VOD and notification items. All test data cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (11 admin tabs, 7 sidebar views, CVR, Media Library, VOD, Notifications, Branding, EPG keyboard nav, channel quality/type) are working correctly. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py cover all new API endpoints. One bug to fix: handleEditChannel in AdminDashboard.jsx doesn't preserve quality_label/channel_type/stream_url when opening edit dialog. Backend API auth requirements are correct: VOD GET and Notifications GET are public; Media GET and Recordings GET require auth.

Channel Edit Form Missing Fields.root_cause: In AdminDashboard.jsx, handleEditChannel resets channelForm to {name, number, description} but quality_label, channel_type, and stream_url are not included. The form fields use channelForm.quality_label || '1080p' to display current values, but since the state was set without these fields, they show defaults instead of the channel's actual values.
Channel Edit Form Missing Fields.reproduction: 1. Create a channel with quality_label='4K' and channel_type='vod'. 2. Click Edit on that channel. 3. The Quality Label dropdown shows '1080p' (default) and Channel Type shows 'Live TV' (default) instead of '4K' and 'VOD Channel'.
Channel Edit Form Missing Fields.mitigation: In handleEditChannel, add: quality_label: channel.quality_label || '1080p', channel_type: channel.channel_type || 'live', stream_url: channel.stream_url || '' to the setChannelForm call.
